variable (S : Submonoid R) [AddCommGroup N'] [Module R N']

variable {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') [IsLocalizedModule S f]
variable {N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N'] [Module R N'] (g : N →ₗ[R] N') [IsLocalizedModule S g]

include f in
/--
If `M` is a finitely presented `R`-module,
then any `Rₛ`-basis of `Mₛ` for some `S : Submonoid R` can be lifted to
a `Rᵣ`-basis of `Mᵣ` for some `r ∈ S`.
-/
lemma Module.FinitePresentation.exists_basis_localizedModule_powers
    (Rₛ) [CommRing Rₛ] [Algebra R Rₛ] [Module Rₛ M'] [IsScalarTower R Rₛ M']
    [IsLocalization S Rₛ] [Module.FinitePresentation R M]
    {I} [Finite I] (b : Basis I Rₛ M') :
    ∃ (r : R) (hr : r ∈ S)
      (b' : Basis I (Localization (.powers r)) (LocalizedModule.Away r M)),
      ∀ i, (LocalizedModule.lift (.powers r) f fun s ↦ IsLocalizedModule.map_units f
        ⟨s.1, SetLike.le_def.mp (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hr) s.2⟩) (b' i) = b i := by
  have : Module.FinitePresentation R (I →₀ R) := Module.finitePresentation_of_projective _ _
  obtain ⟨r, hr, e, he⟩ := Module.FinitePresentation.exists_lift_equiv_of_isLocalizedModule S f
    (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (Algebra.linearMap R Rₛ)) (b.repr.restrictScalars R)
  let e' := IsLocalizedModule.iso (.powers r) (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (α := I)
    (Algebra.linearMap R (Localization (.powers r))))
  refine ⟨r, hr, .ofRepr (e ≪≫ₗ ?_), ?_⟩
  · exact
    { __ := e',
      toLinearMap := e'.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization (.powers r) (Localization (.powers r)) }
  · intro i
    have : e'.symm _ = _ := LinearMap.congr_fun (IsLocalizedModule.iso_symm_comp (.powers r)
      (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (Algebra.linearMap R (Localization (.powers r)))))
      (Finsupp.single i 1)
    simp only [Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap_apply, Finsupp.mapRange_single, Algebra.linearMap_apply,
      map_one, LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap_apply] at this
    change LocalizedModule.lift _ _ _ (e.symm (e'.symm _)) = _
    replace he := LinearMap.congr_fun he (e.symm (e'.symm (Finsupp.single i 1)))
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply] at he
    apply b.repr.injective
    rw [← he, Basis.repr_self, this, LocalizedModule.lift_mk]
    simp

include f in
/--
If `M` is a finitely presented `R`-module
such that `Mₛ` is free over `Rₛ` for some `S : Submonoid R`,
then `Mᵣ` is already free over `Rᵣ` for some `r ∈ S`.
-/
lemma Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers
    (Rₛ) [CommRing Rₛ] [Algebra R Rₛ] [Module Rₛ M'] [IsScalarTower R Rₛ M'] [Nontrivial Rₛ]
    [IsLocalization S Rₛ] [Module.FinitePresentation R M] [Module.Free Rₛ M'] :
=====
    simp_rw [Function.comp_def, c, if_pos, neg_zero, zero_mul, map_zero]
  · rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort _ (fun i ↦ f i • v i), s.sum_insert hn, add_comm, hfn] at hfv
    simp_rw [Pi.add_apply, smul_add, s.sum_add_distrib, c, smul_smul, ← s.sum_smul, ← mul_assoc,
      ← s.sum_mul, mul_neg, s.sum_neg_distrib, ← hfv]
    congr 4
    exact s.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ by rw [if_neg (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hn)]
  obtain hi | hi := Finset.mem_insert.mp hi
  · rw [hi, hfn, Finset.sum_eq_zero, neg_zero, zero_mul]
    intro i hi; rw [ih i hi, zero_mul]
  · exact ih i hi

theorem IsLocalRing.linearCombination_bijective_of_flat [Module.Finite R M] [Flat R M] {ι : Type u}
    (v : ι → M) (h : Function.Bijective (linearCombination k (TensorProduct.mk R k M 1 ∘ v))) :

  · simpa only [top_le_iff, ← range_linearCombination, LinearMap.range_eq_top] using h.2
  · simp

1	/-

3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.

5	-/
6	import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Tower
7	import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Basic
8	
9	/-!
10	# Trivializations of base-changed modules and their transition units
11	
12	Let `A` be a commutative ring and `N` an `A`-module.  A **trivialization** of `N` over an
13	`A`-algebra `C` is a `C`-linear isomorphism `t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C`.  This file develops
14	the elementary calculus of such trivializations that drives the surjectivity half of the
15	Čech–Picard dictionary (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CechPicSurjective`):
16	
17	* `Module.trivialization_ext`: a trivialization is determined by its values on the
18	  tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` (they `C`-span the base change).
19	* `Module.trivializationPush h t`: the pushforward of a trivialization along an
20	  `A`-algebra map `h : C →ₐ[A] C'`, with `trivializationPush_one_tmul` computing it on
21	  `1 ⊗ₜ n` as `h (t (1 ⊗ₜ n))`, and strict compositionality
22	  (`trivializationPush_trivializationPush`).
23	* `Module.transitionUnit t₁ t₂ : Cˣ`: the unit comparing two trivializations, uniquely
24	  characterized by `transitionUnit_mul_apply : transitionUnit t₁ t₂ * t₁ x = t₂ x`
25	  (uniqueness: `transitionUnit_eq_of`).  The cocycle calculus is immediate from the
26	  characterization: `transitionUnit_self`, the telescoping identity
27	  `transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit`, and compatibility with pushforward
28	  (`map_transitionUnit`).
29	
30	On a finite localization cover these transition units become a Čech 1-cocycle presenting
31	the class of an invertible module; see
32	`AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LocalizationTrivialization`.
33	
34	Everything is pinned to a single universe `u`, matching the descent development in
35	`AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.ModuleDescent`.
36	-/
37	
38	universe u
39	
40	open TensorProduct
41	
42	namespace Module
43	
44	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
45	variable {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
46	variable {C' : Type u} [CommRing C'] [Algebra A C']
47	variable {C'' : Type u} [CommRing C''] [Algebra A C'']
48	
49	/-! ## Extensionality on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` -/
50	
51	/-- Two `C`-linear maps out of `C ⊗[A] N` valued in `C` that agree on the tensors
52	`1 ⊗ₜ n` are equal: these tensors `C`-span the base change. -/
53	theorem trivialization_hom_ext {t₁ t₂ : C ⊗[A] N →ₗ[C] C}
54	    (h : ∀ n : N, t₁ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) : t₁ = t₂ := by
55	  apply LinearMap.restrictScalars_injective A
56	  apply TensorProduct.ext'
57	  intro c n
58	  have hc : (c ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) = c • (1 ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) := by
59	    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
60	  simp only [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, hc, map_smul, h]
61	
62	/-- Two trivializations agreeing on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` are equal. -/
63	theorem trivialization_ext {t₁ t₂ : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C}
64	    (h : ∀ n : N, t₁ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) : t₁ = t₂ :=
65	  LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective (trivialization_hom_ext h)
66	
67	/-! ## Pushforward along an algebra map -/
68	
69	/-- The pushforward of a trivialization `t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C` along an `A`-algebra map
70	`h : C →ₐ[A] C'`: the composite
71	`C' ⊗[A] N ≃ C' ⊗[C] (C ⊗[A] N) ≃ C' ⊗[C] C ≃ C'` (with `C'` a `C`-algebra via `h`),
72	which on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` is `h (t (1 ⊗ₜ n))` (`trivializationPush_one_tmul`). -/
73	noncomputable def trivializationPush (h : C →ₐ[A] C') (t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C) :
74	    C' ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C'] C' :=
75	  letI : Algebra C C' := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra
76	  haveI : IsScalarTower A C C' :=
77	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (h.commutes a).symm
78	  ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A C C' C' N).symm.trans
79	    (LinearEquiv.baseChange C C' _ _ t)).trans (AlgebraTensorModule.rid C C' C')
80	
81	@[simp]
82	lemma trivializationPush_one_tmul (h : C →ₐ[A] C') (t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C) (n : N) :
83	    trivializationPush h t (1 ⊗ₜ n) = h (t (1 ⊗ₜ n)) := by
84	  letI : Algebra C C' := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra
85	  haveI : IsScalarTower A C C' :=
86	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (h.commutes a).symm
87	  show (AlgebraTensorModule.rid C C' C')
88	      (LinearEquiv.baseChange C C' _ _ t
89	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A C C' C' N).symm ((1 : C') ⊗ₜ n))) = _
90	  rw [AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul, LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul,
91	    AlgebraTensorModule.rid_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
92	  rfl
93	
94	/-- Pushforward of trivializations is strictly compositional. -/
95	lemma trivializationPush_trivializationPush (h' : C' →ₐ[A] C'') (h : C →ₐ[A] C')
96	    (t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C) :
97	    trivializationPush h' (trivializationPush h t) = trivializationPush (h'.comp h) t :=
98	  trivialization_ext fun n ↦ by
99	    rw [trivializationPush_one_tmul, trivializationPush_one_tmul,
100	      trivializationPush_one_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply]
101	
102	/-! ## Transition units -/
103	
104	section transitionUnit
105	
106	variable (t t₁ t₂ t₃ : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C)
107	
108	/-- The **transition unit** between two trivializations of `N` over `C`: the unit of `C`
109	by which they differ, `transitionUnit t₁ t₂ * t₁ x = t₂ x`
110	(`transitionUnit_mul_apply`). -/
111	noncomputable def transitionUnit : Cˣ where
112	  val := t₂ (t₁.symm 1)
113	  inv := t₁ (t₂.symm 1)
114	  val_inv := by
115	    have h1 : t₂ (t₁.symm 1) • t₂.symm (1 : C) = t₁.symm 1 := by
116	      rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, t₂.symm_apply_apply]
117	    rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul, h1, t₁.apply_symm_apply]
118	  inv_val := by
119	    have h1 : t₁ (t₂.symm 1) • t₁.symm (1 : C) = t₂.symm 1 := by
120	      rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, t₁.symm_apply_apply]
121	    rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul, h1, t₂.apply_symm_apply]
122	
123	lemma transitionUnit_val : (transitionUnit t₁ t₂).val = t₂ (t₁.symm 1) :=
124	  rfl
125	
126	/-- The defining property of the transition unit. -/
127	lemma transitionUnit_mul_apply (x : C ⊗[A] N) :
128	    (transitionUnit t₁ t₂).val * t₁ x = t₂ x := by
129	  rw [transitionUnit_val, mul_comm]
130	  have h1 : t₁ x • t₁.symm (1 : C) = x := by
131	    rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, t₁.symm_apply_apply]
132	  rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul, h1]
133	
134	/-- The transition unit is the unique unit conjugating the values of `t₁` on the tensors
135	`1 ⊗ₜ n` into those of `t₂`. -/
136	lemma transitionUnit_eq_of {u : Cˣ}
137	    (h : ∀ n : N, u.val * t₁ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) : transitionUnit t₁ t₂ = u := by
138	  have key : ∀ x : C ⊗[A] N, u.val * t₁ x = t₂ x := by
139	    intro x
140	    induction x with
141	    | zero => simp
142	    | tmul c n =>
143	        have hc : (c ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) = c • (1 ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) := by
144	          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
145	        rw [hc, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, h]
146	    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, mul_add, hx, hy]
147	  have h1 := key (t₁.symm 1)
148	  rw [t₁.apply_symm_apply, mul_one] at h1
149	  exact Units.ext ((transitionUnit_val t₁ t₂).trans h1.symm)
150	
151	@[simp]
152	lemma transitionUnit_self : transitionUnit t t = 1 :=
153	  transitionUnit_eq_of t t fun n ↦ by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
154	
155	/-- The telescoping identity for transition units: the Čech 1-cocycle relation. -/
156	lemma transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit :
157	    transitionUnit t₂ t₃ * transitionUnit t₁ t₂ = transitionUnit t₁ t₃ :=
158	  (transitionUnit_eq_of t₁ t₃ fun n ↦ by
159	    rw [Units.val_mul, mul_assoc, transitionUnit_mul_apply t₁ t₂,
160	      transitionUnit_mul_apply t₂ t₃]).symm
161	
162	/-- Transition units are compatible with pushforward of trivializations along an
163	`A`-algebra map. -/
164	lemma map_transitionUnit (h : C →ₐ[A] C') :
165	    transitionUnit (trivializationPush h t₁) (trivializationPush h t₂)
166	      = Units.map h.toRingHom.toMonoidHom (transitionUnit t₁ t₂) :=
167	  transitionUnit_eq_of _ _ fun n ↦ by
168	    have := congrArg h (transitionUnit_mul_apply t₁ t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n))
169	    rw [map_mul] at this
170	    rw [trivializationPush_one_tmul, trivializationPush_one_tmul]
171	    exact this
172	
173	end transitionUnit
174	
175	end Module
176

variable {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') [IsLocalizedModule S f]

include f in
/--
If `M` is a finitely presented `R`-module,
then any `Rₛ`-basis of `Mₛ` for some `S : Submonoid R` can be lifted to
a `Rᵣ`-basis of `Mᵣ` for some `r ∈ S`.
